units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 10. Firearms and ammunition for them, other weapons and munitions seized shall be stored in accordance with legislation of the Russian Federation on weapons.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 11. Perishable things seized shall, in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation, be handed over to the relevant organisations for sale or, where sale is impossible, destroyed.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 12. Narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances seized shall be sent for processing or destruction in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products subject to destruction shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 13. Ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products withdrawn from unlawful circulation under legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products and on restricting consumption (drinking) of alcoholic products, and items used for the unlawful production and/or circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products, shall be dismantled and/or removed and stored away from the place of seizure in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of that ethyl alcohol, alcoholic and alcohol-containing products and those items shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 14. Timber and/or products derived from it in the form of unprocessed timber, seized during proceedings in administrative offence cases under Article 8.28 of this Code, shall be transferred for storage, sale, recycling or destruction in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. The procedure and conditions for storing, selling, recycling or destroying such timber and/or derived products in the form of unprocessed timber shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 15. Tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and/or raw materials for their production withdrawn from unlawful circulation under legislation on state regulation of the production and circulation of tobacco articles, tobacco products, nicotine-containing products and raw materials for their production, and items used for unlawful production and/or circulation of those articles and products, shall be dismantled and/or removed and stored away from the place of seizure in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of those products, items and raw materials shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.10. Seizure of things and documents
units.text: 16. Methanol and methanol-containing liquids seized under legislation on state regulation of their circulation, and equipment for manufacturing products using methanol or methanol-containing liquids, shall be dismantled and/or removed and stored away from the place of seizure in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Samples of that methanol and those methanol-containing liquids shall be retained until the ruling in the administrative offence case enters into legal force.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 27.10

units.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
units.text: 1. Things seized shall be valued if:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.11

units.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
units.text: the provision establishing liability for the administrative offence prescribes an administrative fine calculated as a multiple of the value of the things seized;
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.11 · “the provision establishing liability for the administrative…”

units.text: the things seized are perishable and are being sent for sale or destruction;
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.11 · “the things seized are perishable and are being sent for sale or…”

units.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
units.text: ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products withdrawn from circulation under legislation of the Russian Federation are subject to destruction;
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.11 · “ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing…”

units.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
units.text: timber and/or derived products in the form of unprocessed timber seized during proceedings in administrative offence cases under Article 8.28 of this Code are transferred for storage, sale, recycling or destruction.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.11 · “timber and/or derived products in the form of unprocessed…”

units.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
units.text: 2. The value of things seized shall be determined using state-regulated prices where such prices are established. In other cases, their market value shall be used, except for seized goods for personal use carried by individuals across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union, for which the customs value determined under Chapter 37 of the Customs Code of the Eurasian Economic Union shall be used. Where necessary, the value of things seized shall be determined on the basis of an expert opinion.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.11

units.locator: Article 27.11. Valuation of things and other valuables seized
units.text: 3. Foreign currency seized as the object of an administrative offence shall be converted into the currency of the Russian Federation at the Central Bank of the Russian Federation exchange rate in force on the day the administrative offence was committed.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.11

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.label: Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.label: Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 1. A person driving a vehicle of the relevant type in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated, and persons who have committed administrative offences under parts 2 and 3 of Article 11.8, part 1 of Article 11.8.1, part 1 of Article 12.3, part 2 of Article 12.5 and parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 12.7 of this Code, shall be removed from driving until the reason for removal is eliminated.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 1.1. A person driving a vehicle of the relevant type in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated, or a person in respect of whom a procedural order initiating an administrative offence case under Article 12.24 of this Code has been issued, shall undergo an examination for alcohol intoxication under part 6 of this Article. If the person refuses that examination or disagrees with its results, or if there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated despite a negative alcohol intoxication examination result, they shall be referred for a medical examination for intoxication.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 2. Removal from driving a vehicle of the relevant type, examination for alcohol intoxication and referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be carried out by officials authorised to exercise state supervision and control over traffic safety and safe operation of the relevant vehicle type; for drivers of vehicles of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks, they may also be carried out by military motor vehicle inspectorate officials. All these actions shall be carried out in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 3. A record of removal from driving shall be drawn up, or a corresponding entry specifying the date, time, place and grounds for removal, the position, surname and initials of the person applying that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case, and information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure, shall be made in the record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication, the vehicle impoundment record, the administrative offence record, the procedural order initiating an administrative offence case or the ruling in the case, where those procedural documents lack that information. A copy of the removal-from-driving record shall be given to the person subject to the measure.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 3.1. Referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be recorded in a record, a copy of which shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 4. The removal-from-driving record and the record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall specify the date, time, place and grounds for removal or referral, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing up the record, and information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 5. The removal-from-driving record and the record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be signed by the official drawing them up and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: If the person subject to that measure refuses to sign the relevant record, a corresponding entry shall be made in it.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.12 · “If the person subject to that measure refuses to sign the…”

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 6. Examination for alcohol intoxication, documentation of its results and referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be carried out in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 6.1. The criteria providing sufficient grounds to believe that a person is intoxicated and must be referred for a medical examination, and the procedure for conducting a medical examination for intoxication, shall be established by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal governance in healthcare.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 7. The alcohol intoxication examination certificate or medical examination certificate shall be attached to the relevant record, procedural order initiating an administrative offence case or ruling in the case. Copies of the alcohol intoxication examination certificate and/or medical examination certificate shall be given to the person in respect of whom they were drawn up.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.12

units.locator: Article 27.12. Removal from driving a vehicle, examination for alcohol intoxication and medical examination for intoxication
units.text: Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 23.07.2010 No. 169-FZ.
units.label: Art. 27.12 · “Note. Repealed. — Federal Law of 23.07.2010 No. 169-FZ.”

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.label: Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.label: Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 1. Persons who have committed administrative offences, other than those referred to in parts 1 and 1.1 of Article 27.12 of this Code, and in respect of whom there are sufficient grounds to believe they are intoxicated, shall be referred for a medical examination for intoxication.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 2. The persons referred to in part 1 of this Article shall be referred for a medical examination for intoxication in accordance with the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation by officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records under Article 28.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 3. A record of referral for a medical examination for intoxication shall be drawn up, a copy of which shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 4. The referral record shall specify the date, time, place and grounds for referral, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing it up, and information about the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 5. The referral record shall be signed by the official drawing it up and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case. If that person refuses to sign, a corresponding entry shall be made in the record.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 6. The criteria providing sufficient grounds to believe that a person is intoxicated and must be referred for a medical examination, and the procedure for conducting a medical examination for intoxication, shall be established by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal governance in healthcare.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.12.1. Medical examination for intoxication
units.text: 7. The medical examination certificate shall be attached to the relevant record. A copy shall be given to the person in respect of whom it was drawn up.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.12.1

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.label: Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.label: Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 1. To stop violations of the rules for operating, using and driving vehicles of the relevant type under parts 2 and 3 of Article 11.8, part 1 of Article 11.8.1, Articles 11.9, 11.26 and 11.29, part 4 of Article 11.33, part 1 of Article 12.3, part 2 of Article 12.5, parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 12.7, parts 1 and 3 of Article 12.8, parts 4 and 5 of Article 12.16 (as regards failure to comply with no-stopping or no-parking signs used together with an additional-information plate indicating that vehicles are impounded within the signs’ area of operation), parts 2 - 4 and 6 of Article 12.19, parts 1, 4 - 6 and 12 of Article 12.21.1, part 1 of Article 12.21.2, parts 1 - 4 of Article 12.21.5, Article 12.26, part 3 of Article 12.27 and part 2 of Article 14.38 of this Code, a vehicle shall be impounded, meaning its removal from the carriage of passengers and goods by transporting it using another vehicle to the nearest specially designated guarded place (a specialised parking area), and stored there until the reason for impoundment is eliminated; for violations under Articles 11.26 and 11.29 of this Code, it shall also be held until the administrative fine is paid if the vehicle used to commit the violation is leaving the Russian Federation. If, because of its technical characteristics, the vehicle cannot be transported to and placed in a specialised parking area in the event of an administrative offence under parts 1, 4 - 6 and 12 of Article 12.21.1, part 1 of Article 12.21.2 or parts 1 - 4 of Article 12.21.5 of this Code, it shall be impounded by immobilisation using blocking devices. If a vehicle in respect of which an impoundment decision has been made would obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians, its driver or the persons specified in part 3 of this Article may, before impoundment begins, drive it to the nearest place where it will not cause such obstruction. For administrative offences under Articles 11.26 and 11.29, part 4 of Article 11.33 and part 1 of Article 20.25 (as regards failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an offence under Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code, impoundment may be carried out by the driver of the impounded vehicle or the persons specified in part 3 of this Article moving it to the nearest specially designated guarded place (a specialised parking area), or by immobilisation using blocking devices. For an administrative offence under part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code (as regards failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an offence under Article 11.23, 11.26, 11.27 or 11.29 or Chapter 12 of this Code committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state), impoundment shall last until the administrative fine is paid.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 1.1. Impoundment shall be terminated directly at the place of impoundment in the presence of a person entitled to drive the vehicle under the Road Traffic Rules if the reason for impoundment is eliminated before the vehicle intended to transport the impounded vehicle to the specialised parking area starts moving.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 2. Repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-FZ.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 3. A decision to impound a vehicle of the relevant type, terminate impoundment or return the vehicle shall be made by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant administrative offences; for vehicles of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks, it may also be made by military motor vehicle inspectorate officials. Those officials shall draw up an impoundment record or enter the impoundment in the administrative offence record, procedural order initiating an administrative offence case or ruling in the case, where those procedural documents lack the following information: the date, time, place and grounds for the impoundment decision; the position, surname and initials of the person applying that measure securing proceedings; information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure; and the name of the body (institution, organisation), position, surname, first name and patronymic (if any) of the person who will execute the impoundment decision. Those officials shall then remain at the place of impoundment until the vehicle intended to transport the impounded vehicle to the specialised parking area starts moving.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 4. The impoundment record shall specify the date, time, place and grounds for the impoundment decision, the position, surname and initials of the person drawing up the record, information about the vehicle and the person subject to the measure securing proceedings, and the name of the body (institution, organisation), position, surname, first name and patronymic of the person who will execute the impoundment decision.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 5. The impoundment record shall be signed by the official who drew it up and the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 6. If the person whose vehicle is impounded refuses to sign the record, a corresponding entry shall be made in it.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 7. A copy of the vehicle impoundment record shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings and to the person who will execute the impoundment decision.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 8. An impoundment record drawn up in the driver’s absence shall be prepared in the presence of two attesting witnesses or with video recording. A copy of that record, together with the official’s decision to return the impounded vehicle, shall be given to its possessor, the possessor’s representative or a person carrying the documents necessary to drive it, immediately after the reason for impoundment is eliminated.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 9. Transport of vehicles of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation or rescue military formations of the federal executive body authorised to perform civil defence tasks to a specialised parking area, their storage, payment of transport and storage costs and their return shall be governed by the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 10. Transport of vehicles other than those specified in part 9 of this Article to a specialised parking area, their storage and return to possessors, possessors’ representatives or persons carrying the documents necessary to drive them, and payment of transport and storage costs by persons held administratively liable for offences resulting in impoundment shall be governed by the procedure established by the laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation. Impounded vehicles shall be returned to possessors, their representatives or persons carrying the necessary driving documents immediately after the reason for impoundment is eliminated.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 11. Except in the cases specified in part 9 of this Article, a person held administratively liable for an offence resulting in impoundment shall pay the transport and storage costs within the time limits and at the rates set by the authorised executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in accordance with methodological guidelines approved by the authorised federal executive body responsible for adopting regulatory legal acts and monitoring compliance with legislation on state regulation of prices (tariffs) for goods (services). The person’s duty to pay the transport and storage costs shall be reflected in the ruling imposing an administrative penalty.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13. Impoundment of a vehicle
units.text: 12. Where proceedings in an administrative offence case are terminated on the grounds provided for by point 1, point 2 (other than where an individual had not attained the age for administrative liability under this Code at the time of the unlawful action or omission, or the case materials are referred to a prosecutor, preliminary investigation body or inquiry body because the unlawful action or omission contains indications of a crime), or points 3, 8, 8.1 and 9 of part 1 of Article 24.5 of this Code, the transport and storage costs shall be charged to the federal budget, or, where the case was handled by an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to that constituent entity’s budget. If proceedings are terminated on other grounds, the person who committed the unlawful action or omission resulting in impoundment, their parents or other legal representatives shall bear the transport and storage costs. The decision to charge those costs to the federal budget or the budget of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or to impose the duty to pay them on the person who committed the unlawful action or omission resulting in impoundment, their parents or other legal representatives, shall be reflected in the ruling terminating proceedings.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 27.13

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. A vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation by the officials specified in points 8 and 10.1 of part 1 of Article 27.2 of this Code may be detained to establish the circumstances of an administrative offence and ensure proper and timely consideration of a case concerning an offence for which administrative liability is established by part 2 of Article 8.17, Articles 8.18 - 8.20 or part 2 of Article 11.7.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. A vessel shall be detained by officials authorised to draw up records of the relevant administrative offences.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. A vessel detention record shall be drawn up. A copy shall be given to the person subject to that measure securing proceedings in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. The period of vessel detention shall run from the moment the detention record is drawn up and may not exceed 72 hours. Upon expiry, the vessel shall be released or placed under attachment in accordance with Article 27.14.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. In the event of detention of a foreign vessel, the federal executive body responsible for foreign affairs shall immediately notify the diplomatic mission or consular institution of the vessel’s flag state in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.13.1

units.locator: Article 27.13.1. Detention of a vessel brought to a port of the Russian Federation
units.text: 6. The procedure for storage, upkeep, safe berthing and return of detained vessels, and reimbursement to port infrastructure possessors of expenses associated with storage of the vessel and provision for its crew’s subsistence, shall be established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.13.1
